title: Garden and Harbor
author: Ines Nystrom
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
